chapters.2.meaning: Women and men shape Judah's family history. The list includes people from other nations.
chapters.8.meaning: Benjamin's family list leads to Saul. His family later gives Israel its first king.
chapters.9.meaning: Worship depends on daily work. Guards, singers, and other workers care for the temple.
chapters.11.meaning: David refuses water brought at great risk. He honors the men who risked their lives.
chapters.12.meaning: Men from many tribes join David. Their support helps unite Israel under one king.
chapters.13.meaning: Uzza's death turns celebration into fear. David leaves the ark with Obed-Edom.
chapters.13.lds: Why does David stop moving the ark? What changes when he tries again?
chapters.15.meaning: Levites carry the ark as Moses taught. David changes how he brings it to Jerusalem.
chapters.17.meaning: David wants to build God's house. God instead promises to establish David's royal family.
chapters.18.meaning: David's victories bring wealth to Israel. Gifts and war supplies help prepare for the temple.
chapters.20.meaning: Joab captures Rabbah while David stays in Jerusalem. The verse describes severe violence against its people.
chapters.21.lds: David asks why the people must suffer. What does his response show about responsibility?
chapters.24.meaning: Lots assign the priests' turns to serve. Each family receives a place in the work.
chapters.25.meaning: Teachers and students receive turns by lot. Music joins skilled work with worship.
chapters.26.meaning: Temple worship needs guards and supplies. These workers protect the gates and care for stored gifts.
chapters.27.meaning: The kingdom needs workers beyond its army. Farmers, herders, storekeepers, and advisers support daily life.
chapters.29.meaning: David says their wealth first came from God. Giving returns part of what they received.
people.tamar.meaning: Judah's family line continues through her sons Perez and Zerah.
people.obed.meaning: He links Boaz's family with Jesse and King David.
people.jarha.meaning: This Egyptian servant marries Sheshan's daughter. Their family continues through Attai.
people.amnon.meaning: David's family list names him as the first son born at Hebron.
people.caleb.meaning: Joshua's companion receives a family place in Judah's records.
people.miriam.meaning: Amram's family includes her with Moses and Aaron.
people.eleazar.meaning: Aaron's son continues the priestly family line.
people.phinehas.meaning: The book recalls his earlier leadership over those who guarded the entrance.
people.ethan-singer.meaning: He joins Heman and Asaph in leading music before the ark.
people.manasseh.meaning: His descendants form one of the tribes listed in Israel's family records.
people.sheerah.meaning: The record credits her with building Beth Horon and Uzzen Sheerah.
people.benjamin.meaning: His family line leads to the tribe that includes Saul.
people.shallum-gatekeeper.meaning: He leads a family of gatekeepers. Their work guards the entrance to worship.
people.eleazar-dodai.meaning: David's warrior stands with him in battle. His father is named Dodo.
people.benaiah.meaning: His brave acts win him a place over David's bodyguard.
people.uriah.meaning: David's warrior list includes Uriah the Hittite. Samuel tells how David ordered his death.
people.abinadab-ark.meaning: His house holds the ark before David brings it toward Jerusalem.
people.uzzah.meaning: He reaches toward the ark when the oxen stumble. His death makes David afraid.
people.obed-edom.meaning: He keeps the ark in his house for three months. His household receives blessings.
people.obed-edom-jeduthun.meaning: He receives a gatekeeping duty during the arrangements for worship.
people.hosah.meaning: He gives Shimri the chief place among his sons. Birth order does not decide that duty.
people.nathan-prophet.meaning: He first supports David's building plan. God's message then changes the answer he brings.
people.joram-hamath.meaning: Hamath's king sends his son to greet David and bring gifts after the victory.
people.ahimelech-abiathar.meaning: Abiathar's son helps with the priestly duties and the division of service.
people.jonathan-shimei.meaning: David's nephew kills a giant who challenges Israel.
people.goliath.meaning: The battle account names him as Lahmi's brother. Elhanan kills Lahmi.
people.gad.meaning: He brings David a choice of judgments after the count. He later directs an altar offering.
people.ornan-sons.meaning: Ornan's four sons hide when they see the angel.
people.gershom-moses.meaning: His family continues through the Levite service lists.
people.eliezer-moses.meaning: His family grows through his son Rehabiah.
people.obed-edom-gatekeeper.meaning: His large family receives duties at the temple gates.
people.shelomoth-treasurer.meaning: He cares for gifts that earlier leaders set aside for the temple.
people.jaziz.meaning: This Hagrite cares for David's flocks.
chapters.7.summary: Several northern tribes receive family lists. Ephraim mourns his sons. Sheerah builds towns, and Joshua's ancestors are named.
chapters.12.summary: Supporters join David during his flight from Saul. Amasai promises loyalty. Groups gather at Hebron with food and soldiers.
chapters.26.title: Gatekeepers, stored gifts, and public duties
chapters.27.summary: The list names army groups, tribal leaders, farm workers, and advisers. It also recalls the unfinished count.
chapters.29.title: Gifts, prayer, a new king, and David's death
people.reuben.meaning: Judah's family supplies kings. Joseph's sons receive the firstborn share.
people.hiram.meaning: He sends wood and workers to David. Their help builds David's house.
people.hanun.meaning: He humiliates David's messengers. Hired allies join him in the war that follows.
